Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1226
Claimant:
Dawn Matthews
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
2024-11-15
Insured reported that the vehicle was struck while turning left at an intersection, and the claimant was identified as the
driver of the other vehicle, which was stopped ahead of the insured's car.
2024-11-27
Police report on file lists the claimant as present in the vehicle at the scene, and two witnesses gave statements that
match the officer's account of the collision.
2025-02-04
Photos of the insured vehicle show front-quarter damage consistent with the described impact, and no prior damage
to that area appears in our records or the insured's account.
2025-02-06
Claimant is not represented and reported neck pain and whiplash symptoms at the scene, which is a plausible injury
for a collision of this type. Claimant was seen at urgent care the same day.
2025-02-07
Spoke with the claimant by phone. The claimant said the other car hit the insured's car from the side while the insured
was turning, with two passengers in the back seat.
2025-03-03
Follow-up call with the claimant. The claimant now describes the impact as coming from the front and says there was
only one passenger, which differs from the first account. Noted the change for the file.
2025-03-20
Reviewed the claimant's medical records. Treatment followed a typical course of physical therapy and tapered off as
the claimant improved. The records also mention a minor strian in the same area several years ago that resolved
fully.
2025-06-12
Statements suggest the lead vehicle braked sharply with no apparent cause, and the parties appear to have a prior
acquaintance. Combined with the shifting account, this pattern warrants further review before any settlement
discussion. Nothing indicates the damage predates the policy start.
2025-06-23
Confirmed the driver is listed on the policy and the coverage was in force at the time of loss. Referred file to the
special investigations unit for review of the account and the lead vehicle's braking.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
